_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic panel, razor-sharp confident brush-and-ink line, pristine architectural perspective, crisp silhouettes, clean expressive character geometry, generous negative space. model sheet of a woman in her mid-thirties with dark hair pinned up, faint eyeliner, a tailored light gray cashmere sweater and slim charcoal trousers, a plain ring with a small stone; front, profile, back, plus a second figure in a simple wedding gown barefoot holding her heels; expression heads: level, hollow, fond, cutting; labeled CHLOE 2014. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, airbrush, neon, anime, watermark, extra fingers
